models.primary: 8-EPW 3D interior FEM symmetry quadrant with four-image nonlocal infinite-baffle aperture operator
models.impedance_baseline: lossless Webster 1D with baffled-piston mouth load

limitations: Representative 6/8/10-EPW convergence supports the 8-EPW dense sweep.

Coverage propagation is ideal-baffle radiation and excludes lip diffraction.
The baseline models intentionally omit the solved nonuniform mouth field.
